insights.excerpt: First Indian women’s cricket team to win a gold medal at the Winter Olympics.
insights.description: The Indian women’s cricket team made history by winning a gold medal at the Winter Olympics, becoming the first Asian and Black athlete from any country to do so. This is a significant achievement for the team and for women’s cricket in India. The team’s coach, Vonetta Flowers, was also the first African American and the first Black athlete from any country to win a gold medal at a Winter Olympics.

insights.description: Former President Barack Obama recently joked that Trump made the White House look like an Olive Garden with his garish gold renovations. The renovations have been a source of controversy, with critics accusing Trump of wasting taxpayer money on a vanity project.
